يرم (form I)
# يَرُمُّ (yarummu) /ja.rum.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of رَمَّ (ramma)
# يُرَمُّ (yurammu) /ju.ram.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of رَمَّ (ramma)
# يَرُمَّ (yarumma) /ja.rum.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَمَّ (ramma)
# يُرَمَّ (yuramma) /ju.ram.ma/: third-person masc
